name: Minecraft Agent
description: A Minecraft Java Agent body for DSH with shared visualization, navigation, inventory, game memory and an optional isolated-experiment dashboard. Supports stock DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 without a host patch; installation starts no game or model.
descriptionZh: DSH 我的世界 Agent：共享画面、导航、背包、游戏记忆与可选独立实验室。直接兼容原始官方 DSH0.2.1-rc.2，无需修补宿主；主维护 Java1.21.1，安装不启动游戏或模型。
